newsitem.title: SURINAM: Suriname's Central Bank president resigns.
newsitem.headline: Suriname's Central Bank president resigns.

text.p: Suriname's Central Bank President Andre Telting handed his resignation to President Jules Wijdenbosch on Wednesday in disagreement over recent appointments to the bank's board, a Central Bank spokesman said Thursday.
Telting was angered by Wijdenbosch's decision to name former bank President Henk Goedschalk as Government Commissioner on the bank's board of directors.
"Since I don't think a good working relationship with Goedschalk is possible, I will draw the obvious conclusion," he said recently.
It was not immediately clear who would replace Telting as president of the bank, the spokesman said.

Goedschalk was head of the Central Bank until Telting's appointment three years ago after being forced to step down amid a corruption scandal. Goedschalk's involvement in corrupt practices was not proven.
Telting has been widely credited as the author of a successful economic program in Suriname which has seen inflation drop from nearly 600 percent to single figures in two years.
